candidate_task.name: TopoCF-All-Observed-v2
candidate_task.shared_payload: the union of sentence evidence for all four observed mention edges is identical in the positive and negative candidate

motivation.predecessor_failure: synthetic-common T3 labels are recoverable by independently checking whether swapped title-mention edges are textually grounded
motivation.required_improvement: both candidate bindings must contain only observed and textually grounded local edges so that local edge reality cannot reveal the label

population_audit.content_contract: aggregate counts, histograms, runtime, and hashes only; no question IDs, questions, answers, contexts, titles, or sentences
population_audit.context_pool: all documents supplied in each official HotpotQA distractor-format record; this is not a full-corpus retrieval claim

post_audit_rules.if_passed: freeze question-disjoint train fit/validation IDs and reserve every official-dev candidate for one-shot evaluation before training any verifier
post_audit_rules.if_failed: do not weaken the all-observed condition; test a different official dataset or graph construction
